_comment: Citation for the 10e universal Smokescreen core Wargear Stratagem. Built env-gated behind SWEG_SMOKESCREEN (durability fidelity wave, audit B fix 1). Verbatim text independently re-verified against https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/Stratagems.csv per CLAUDE.md rule 6/10 (BSData carries no stratagem text at all, confirmed by a repo-wide scan of every cached *.cat.gz for a <stratagem> element).

simulator.smokescreen.quoted_text: Smokescreen — 1CP. Core - Wargear Stratagem. WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets. TARGET: One SMOKE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks. EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, all models in your unit have the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability.
simulator.smokescreen.trigger: the opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected a friendly [SMOKE] unit as the target of one or more of its attacks
simulator.smokescreen.effect: the defending army spends 1 Command Point so that, until the end of the phase, every model in the targeted [SMOKE] unit has the Benefit of Cover (+1 to the armour saving throw) AND the Stealth ability (-1 to be hit by ranged attacks). Implemented as Battle._maybe_smokescreen (env-gated SWEG_SMOKESCREEN, default on), hooked at the target-selection point in Battle._do_shoot immediately after the existing Go To Ground check: the Benefit of Cover is applied via the smokescreen_active flag in the _do_shoot cover application (same site as Go To Ground's in_cover grant), and the Stealth -1 to hit is composed via OR with profile.stealth at the Stealth hit-modifier branch in Unit.attack. [SMOKE]-carrier eligibility is enumerated from BSData v10.6.0 (every unit selectionEntry across all 46 cached catalogue files carrying a direct categoryLink name="Smoke"), hardcoded as Battle._SMOKE_UNITS (192 catalogue entries, faction-neutral — not limited to Death Guard) because a full mapper regeneration of data/bsdata/parsed.json is independently stale relative to current code and would perturb unrelated units' stats (see the long comment above _SMOKE_UNITS in code/simulator.py). The defender only smokes a unit whose remaining wounds and incoming threat justify the Command Point (>= half the unit's current health), gated by the same worth-protecting AI heuristic shape as Go To Ground (minimum alive models / minimum solo wounds), capped by the Command Point pool; the heuristic is even-handed ([SMOKE] keyword + wounds + threat + Command Points only, no faction awareness). The buff clears with the other per-round transient stratagem flags. Gate unset (SWEG_SMOKESCREEN=0) reproduces the baseline byte-for-byte (no Command Point spent, no flag set, no extra random draws).
